Subject: Kickoff: POC MAP & evaluation plan - CardiaTech

Hi Devon / Emma —

Nice to finally get this on calendar. As discussed in the demo last week, this thread will be our canonical MAP kickoff and living plan for the 6-week POC. Goal here is to align on success criteria, owner assignments (prompts / evals / benchmarks), and a tight close timeline so both teams know what to prioritize.

High-level POC objective:
- Validate Redwood Inference end-to-end for CardiaTech triage-assist workflow (throughput, latency, and precision against annotated cases).

Proposed success criteria (acceptance gates):
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for 512-token sequences in your staging region under synthetic load (defined in attached benchmark-specs.pdf).
2) Quality: F1 >= 0.78 on labeled triage set (50 clinical vignettes + 150 synthetic variations).
3) Stability: <1% error rate and no critical OOMs during a 2-hour ramp test at target throughput.
4) Integration: API contract validated and end-to-end example (staging) demonstrated by week 4.

Draft timeline (attached MAP-draft.xlsx has milestones):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, stakeholder roster, baseline dataset delivery (CardiaTech)
- Week 1–2: Bench design & prompt ownership; initial model coupling + run 0
- Week 3: Quality evaluation, quick iterations on prompts/rollouts
- Week 4: Stress testing and SLA checks
- Week 5–6: Final acceptance + close / contract discussion

Owners (proposed):
- Prompt owner / prompt deck: Marissa Cole
- Evaluation lead (bench design, metrics): Ben Carter
- Benchmark automation & ramp tests: Naomi Feldman
- Account lead / commercial coordination: Alex Martinez (me)

Attachments: MAP-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones), benchmark-specs.pdf (bench harness + metrics).

Immediate asks for CardiaTech team:
1) Confirm the two technical contacts who will provide the labeled triage set and access to staging (we currently have Devon and Emma copied).
2) Confirm that the acceptance gates above align with your expectations or call out changes.
3) If you want a separate security/compliance kickoff, indicate availability next week (we can loop in Redwood Security).

Proposed kickoff call (record + notes link in related_links). If those owners work for you, I’ll lock the MAP and send the calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-draft.xlsx (xlsx), benchmark-specs.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Alex — this looks solid. Quick notes from our side: we agree with the acceptance gates but would like the F1 target to be a stretch goal (0.78 as aspirational) and set a minimum pass of 0.72 for the POC. We also want to add a usability checkpoint after Week 3 with a small panel of triage nurses to validate suggested outputs (will provide contact).

Technical contacts: Devon Lee (me) and Emma Ruiz (eng lead) will be the primary staging contacts. We will deliver the 50 labeled vignettes by EOD next Monday (2028-05-22).

One ask: please include a short appendix in the MAP that outlines prompt-ownership change control — who can push prompt changes during the POC and what rollback looks like.

Happy to do the security kickoff; our compliance lead (Leah Park) is available May 23–25.

— Devon
